# Burrow

> Burrow is a modular Go web framework for server-rendered web applications. Built on Chi, Den (object-document mapper with SQLite + PostgreSQL backends), and Go's html/template. Deploy as a single binary.

Burrow follows the Django/Rails philosophy: composable apps with their own routes, middleware, and templates — but with Go's performance and single-binary deployment. Pure-Go SQLite via Den (`modernc.org/sqlite`) means zero external runtime dependencies; switch to PostgreSQL via DSN with no code changes.

Burrow is designed for server-rendered web applications, not API-only services.

## Core Concepts

- [Quick Start](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/getting-started/quickstart/): Minimal app setup
- [Creating an App](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/creating-an-app/): Build a custom app with routes, templates, and documents
- [Core Interfaces](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/interfaces/): App, HasDocuments, HasRoutes, HasMiddleware, HasTemplates, Configurable, HasAdmin, and more
- [Core Functions](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/core-functions/): HandlerFunc, Handle, Render, Bind, Validate, JSON, Text, HTML
- [Routing](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/routing/): Handlers, error handling, URL parameters, middleware
- [Database](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/database/): Den ODM, SQLite + PostgreSQL backends, repository pattern
- [Layouts & Rendering](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/layouts/): Template rendering, layout wrapping, HTMX support
- [Configuration](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/configuration/): CLI flags, environment variables, TOML config
- [Internationalization](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/i18n/): Built-in i18n with Accept-Language detection and go-i18n translations

## Contrib Apps

- [Admin](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/admin/): Admin panel coordinator (top-nav layout, dashboard cards, route mounting); ships `admin/pagination`
- [Auth](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/auth/): WebAuthn/passkey authentication with recovery codes
- [Auth Mail](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/authmail/): Pluggable email rendering with SMTP backend
- [CSRF](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/csrf/): CSRF protection via gorilla/csrf
- [Healthcheck](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/healthcheck/): Liveness and readiness probes
- [htmx](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/htmx/): HTMX integration with request/response helpers + dialog pattern
- [Humanize](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/humanize/): i18n-aware template functions (naturaltime, intcomma, filesizeformat)
- [Jobs](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/jobs/): SQLite-backed background job queue
- [Messages](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/messages/): Flash messages
- [Rate Limiting](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/ratelimit/): Per-client token bucket rate limiting
- [Security Headers](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/secure/): Security response headers (X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, CSP)
- [Session](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/session/): Cookie-based sessions via gorilla/sessions
- [SSE](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/sse/): Server-Sent Events with in-memory pub/sub broker
- [Static Files](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/contrib/staticfiles/): Content-hashed static file serving

## Other Packages

- [Uploader](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/guide/uploader/): HTTP file-upload helpers built on `den.Storage`. Supports Range/conditional GET when the storage implements `den.SeekableStorage` (file backend); falls back to plain streaming for remote backends (S3 etc.) where Range belongs at the URL layer (pre-signed URLs).

## Reference

- [Server & Registry](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/server/): Server boot sequence, registry API
- [Configuration Reference](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/configuration/): All flags, env vars, TOML keys
- [Template Functions](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/template-functions/): Built-in template functions
- [Context Helpers](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/context-helpers/): Request context accessors
- [Reusable Templates](https://burrow.readthedocs.io/reference/reusable-templates/): Named templates from contrib apps (htmx/js, htmx/config, admin/pagination, etc.)

## Quick Conventions for Coding Agents

These are the non-obvious patterns and rules that matter most when generating Burrow code.

### Handler Pattern

Handlers return `error` — never call `http.Error()` directly:

```go
r.Get("/notes", burrow.Handle(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
    notes, err := repo.List(r.Context())
    if err != nil {
        if errors.Is(err, den.ErrNotFound) {
            return burrow.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "not found")
        }
        return err // 500, logged automatically
    }
    return burrow.Render(w, r, http.StatusOK, "notes/list", notes)
}))
```

Return `burrow.NewHTTPError(code, msg)` for client errors (404, 403, etc.). Any other error becomes a 500. **Always `errors.Is`-check for `den.ErrNotFound` before mapping repository errors to 404** — otherwise a transient DB outage silently surfaces as 404.

### App Structure

Every app lives in its own package and implements `burrow.App`:

```go
func (a *myApp) Name() string { return "notes" }
func (a *myApp) Configure(cfg *burrow.AppConfig, cmd *cli.Command) error { /* init repos, services */ }
```

Optional interfaces add capabilities: `HasRoutes`, `HasMiddleware`, `HasTemplates`, `HasDocuments`, `HasFlags`, `Configurable`, `PostConfigurable`, `Startable`, `HasFuncMap`, `HasRequestFuncMap`, `HasNavItems`, `HasAdmin`, `HasTranslations`, `HasDependencies`, `HasJobs`, `HasStaticFiles`, `HasShutdown`.

File layout: `app.go`, `context.go`, `handlers.go`, `middleware.go`, `models.go`, `repository.go`, `templates/*.html`.

### Models & Database

Den is an ODM (object-document mapper) over SQLite or PostgreSQL. Pure Go, no CGO required for the SQLite backend.

```go
import (
    "github.com/oliverandrich/den"
    "github.com/oliverandrich/den/document"
)

type Note struct {
    document.Base
    Title string `json:"title" verbose:"Title"`
    Body  string `json:"body" verbose:"Body"`
}
```

Document IDs are ULIDs (string). Schema is created automatically on startup via `den.Register()` driven by the `HasDocuments` interface — no SQL migration files. Index hints come from struct tags (`den:"index"`, `den:"unique"`).

**Backend selection — opt-in via blank-import**: every binary using `burrow.OpenDB` must blank-import the Den backend that matches its DSN in its own `main.go`:

```go
import (
    _ "github.com/oliverandrich/den/backend/sqlite"   // for sqlite:// DSNs
    _ "github.com/oliverandrich/den/backend/postgres" // for postgres:// DSNs
)
```

Burrow does not pull either backend in by default, so production binaries only link the engine they actually use.

### Templates

All templates are parsed into a single global `*template.Template`. Namespace with app name:

```html
{{ define "notes/list" }}
<h1>Notes</h1>
{{ range .Items }}<p>{{ .Title }}</p>{{ end }}
{{ end }}
```

Embed template files in the app:

```go
//go:embed templates/*.html
var templateFS embed.FS
```

### Context Helpers

Each package owns its context accessors. Naming convention — getter: `X(ctx)`, setter: `WithX(ctx, val)`:

```go
user := auth.CurrentUser(ctx)
token := csrf.Token(ctx)
items := burrow.NavItems(ctx)
layout := burrow.Layout(ctx)
```

Context helpers never live in the root `burrow` package unless they are core framework concerns.

### Response Helpers

- `burrow.Render(w, r, code, templateName, data)` — render template with layout wrapping
- `burrow.JSON(w, code, v)` — JSON response
- `burrow.Text(w, code, s)` — plain text
- `burrow.HTML(w, code, s)` — raw HTML
- `htmx.SmartRedirect(w, r, url)` — `HX-Redirect` header for HTMX requests, plain HTTP redirect otherwise (always prefer over manual `if IsHTMX else http.Redirect`)

### Request Binding & Validation

```go
var input CreateNoteInput
if err := burrow.Bind(r, &input); err != nil { return err } // body only (JSON / form)
if err := burrow.Validate(input); err != nil { return err }
```

Use `validate` struct tags. `*ValidationError` has `[]FieldError` and `HasField()`. `Bind` reads only the request body — combine with `chi.URLParam(r, "id")` and `r.URL.Query().Get(...)` for other input sources.

### Routing

Uses chi directly — `chi.URLParam(r, "id")` for path params. Middleware is stdlib `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`.

### Pagination

```go
pr := burrow.ParsePageRequest(r)
result := burrow.OffsetResult(pr, totalCount)
url := burrow.PageURL(basePath, r.URL.RawQuery, page) // preserves existing query params
```

Use the `admin/pagination` template (shipped by `contrib/admin`) for ready-made `<nav>` rendering.
